Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_local_time DATE;
 PROCEDURE check_for_duplicate IS
 n_cnt NUMBER;
 BEGIN
 SELECT count(1) INTO n_cnt
 FROM valid_city_state
 WHERE city = :NEW_CITY_STATE.CITY
 AND state = :NEW_CITY_STATE.STATE
 AND zip = :NEW_CITY_STATE.ZIP
 AND TRUNC(v_local_time) BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, TRUNC(v_local_time)+1);
 
 IF n_cnt <> 0 THEN
 show_error('5218');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END check_for_duplicate;

begin
 if :new_city_state.state is null
 or :new_city_state.city is null
 -- or :new_city_state.county is null -- MLT 2260
 or :new_city_state.eff_date is null then
 show_error( '0080' );
 check_package_failure;
 else
 -- SCR 152349
 v_local_time := LIFETRACK_TIMEZONE_CONVERT.GET_LOCAL_TIME(:GLOBAL.CHAPTER_ID, SYSDATE);
 
 
 IF GLOBALVAR.update_mode THEN
 -- In update mode, check for duplicates if any of city, state or zip is modified.
 IF GLOBALVAR.old_city <> :NEW_CITY_STATE.CITY
 OR
 GLOBALVAR.old_state <> :NEW_CITY_STATE.STATE
 OR
 GLOBALVAR.old_zip <> :NEW_CITY_STATE.ZIP
 THEN
 check_for_duplicate;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 check_for_duplicate; 
 END IF;
 -- 
 :system.message_level := '10';
 commit_form;
 :system.message_level := '0';
 show_error('0000');
 exit_form( no_validate );
/*
 clear_block( no_validate );
 hide_window( 'pop_window');
*/
 end if;
end;

exception

end;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
-- Modified for Y2K.....MG.....6/99
PROCEDURE initialise_windows IS
 lv_title VARCHAR2(100);
BEGIN
 --:global.program_version := '1.01.00';
 --:global.program_version := '2.03.00';
 --:global.program_version := '3.01.00';
 --:global.program_version := '01';
 --:global.program_version := '02';
 --:global.program_version := '03'; -- Duplicate objects removal from GRP_LAF_STND
 -- :global.program_version := '04'; -- SCR 152349 - Validation added to check for duplicates.
 
 -- Below Version Got Re-Updated from LT2018
 --:global.program_version := '01';
 --:global.program_version := '02'; -- MLT 2260
 --:global.program_version := '03'; -- MLT 5917
 --:global.program_version := '04'; -- MLT 6060 -- V04
 :global.program_version := '05'; -- MLT-6701 
 -- 1) TZ applied for ter date check. 
 -- 2) GLOBALVAR introduced, to keep track of city,state,zip changes
 -- Check for duplicate only if city, state or zip changes in update mode.
 -- always checks for duplicate in new zip mode. No changes made for this.
 
 execute_trigger('util_banner');
 :system.message_level :='10';

 set_item_property('toolbar.previous_block',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_item_property('toolbar.next_block',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_item_property('toolbar.insert',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_item_property('toolbar.commit_form',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_item_property('toolbar.clear_block',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_item_property('toolbar.clear_record',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_item_property('toolbar.clear_fld',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_item_property('toolbar.delete_record',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 

 
 IF :PARAMETER.P_USPS_ID IS NULL THEN
 
 GLOBALVAR.update_mode := FALSE;
 GLOBALVAR.old_city := NULL;
 GLOBALVAR.old_state := NULL;
 GLOBALVAR.old_county := NULL;
 GLOBALVAR.old_zip := NULL;
 
 lv_title := 'New ZIP Code';
 GO_BLOCK('NEW_CITY_STATE');
 ELSE
 lv_title := 'Update ZIP Code';
 GO_BLOCK('NEW_CITY_STATE');
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '10';
 EXECUTE_QUERY;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '0';
 
 GLOBALVAR.update_mode := TRUE;
 GLOBALVAR.old_city := :NEW_CITY_STATE.CITY;
 GLOBALVAR.old_state := :NEW_CITY_STATE.STATE;
 GLOBALVAR.old_county := :NEW_CITY_STATE.COUNTY;
 GLOBALVAR.old_zip := :NEW_CITY_STATE.ZIP;
 END IF;
 
 :ctrl_blk.local_date := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate);
 
 set_window_property('pop_window', title,
 '[' || :banner.prog_name || ' ' || :global.program_version || '] ' ||
 lv_title );

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GLOBALVAR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PACKAGE GLOBALVAR IS
 update_mode BOOLEAN := FALSE;
 old_city VARCHAR2(40);
 old_state VARCHAR2(2);
 old_county VARCHAR2(40);
 old_zip VARCHAR2(5);
END;

RecordGroup.Name: RG_STATE
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
SELECT DISTINCT
 code,
 description
FROM
 valid_master_codes
WHERE
 code_type = 'STATE'
AND 
 :ctrl_blk.local_date BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, :ctrl_blk.local_date)
ORDER BY
 code

RecordGroup.Name: RG_CITY
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
SELECT DISTINCT
 city
FROM
 valid_city_state
WHERE
 state = :new_city_state.state
AND 
 :ctrl_blk.local_date BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, :ctrl_blk.local_date)
ORDER BY
 city

RecordGroup.Name: RG_COUNTY
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
SELECT DISTINCT
 county
FROM
 valid_city_state
WHERE
 state = :new_city_state.state
AND 
 :ctrl_blk.local_date BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, :ctrl_blk.local_date) 
ORDER BY
 county
